title: Daily 850-hPa temperature advection and 200-hPa jet diagnostics

advection.derivatives: centred differences on the native 0.25-degree grid (xarray.differentiate)

jet.core_latitude: latitude of maximum longitude-mean zonal wind

terrain_mask.source: ETOPO1 cell-mean elevation on the ERA5 grid (01_raw_data/geospatial)
terrain_mask.neighbours: four neighbours of every masked point also excluded
terrain_mask.applies_to: 850-hPa advection box means; the 200-hPa jet is not masked
